verdict.rationale: Babylon.js is a 3D rendering and game engine library. It has no concept of user-defined automations or workflows that could be versioned, reviewed, or rolled back, so this automation-depth axis is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships such a capability. Its code is versioned through the user's own source control, which is a user-side workaround rather than a product feature.
